statBlock.name: Bandit
statBlock.description: A roadside outlaw armed with a scimitar and a light crossbow.

sections.Actions:
Scimitar. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Light Crossbow. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Bandit Captain
statBlock.description: A gang leader who fights with a scimitar and pistol and can turn aside a close strike.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Scimitar or Pistol for each.
Scimitar. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Pistol. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 30/90 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack hits the captain while it is holding a weapon, it adds 2 to its AC against that attack. This can turn the hit into a miss.

statBlock.name: Berserker
statBlock.description: A greataxe fighter whose attacks grow more reliable after taking a serious wound.

sections.Traits: Bloodied Frenzy. While Bloodied, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
sections.Actions: Greataxe. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Cultist
statBlock.description: A devotee who fights with a ritual sickle that leaves a trace of necrotic harm.

sections.Actions: Ritual Sickle. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 1 necrotic damage.

statBlock.name: Druid
statBlock.description: A guardian of the wild who strikes with a living staff and sends radiant wisps after distant foes.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp for each.
Vine Staff. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage.
Verdant Wisp. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 90 ft. A hit deals 10 (3d6) radiant damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action, using Wisdom with a spell save DC of 13.
At will. Druidcraft, Speak with Animals.
2/day each. Entangle, Thunderwave.
1/day each. Animal Messenger, Longstrider, Moonbeam.

statBlock.name: Gladiator
statBlock.description: An arena fighter who throws or thrusts with a spear and uses a shield to knock opponents down.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Spear attacks. The gladiator can replace one with Shield Bash.
Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Shield Bash. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it takes 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone if it is Medium or smaller.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack hits the gladiator while it is holding a weapon, it adds 3 to its AC against that attack. This can turn the hit into a miss.

statBlock.name: Priest
statBlock.description: A member of the clergy who strikes with radiant power and uses cleric magic to aid allies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Mace or Radiant Flame for each.
Mace. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage.
Radiant Flame. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d10) radiant damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom.
At will. Light, Thaumaturgy.
1/day. Spirit Guardians.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Aid (3/day total). Cast Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, or Lesser Restoration using Wisdom. The four spells draw from the same pool of three uses.
sections.Spell save DC: Use DC 13 for spells that call for a save. The source names Wisdom but gives no DC. This value uses the priest's Wisdom modifier of +3 and proficiency bonus of +2.
